query:
UPDATE copies
         SET release_id = ?, status = COALESCE(?, status), format = ?, device_id = ?,
             store_id = ?, condition = ?, notes = ?, edition = ?, purchased_on = ?,
             price = ?, currency = ?, barcode = ?, updated_by = ?,
             updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
         WHERE id = ?
